name: Necromancer
source:
He is freed from his imprisonment by an orc chieftain and his tribe after making a pact with them as an ally of the Witches. He seeks the "Witches' Legacy" and is willing to sacrifice anything to achieve his goals. An extremely powerful sorcerer, he is capable of raising limitless hordes of undead to fight for him.

[Spoiler] A former lecturer at a magical academy, his wife and daughter were falsely accused of being infiltrated witches and were executed unjustly by the Inquisition. In his search to bring them back to life, he learnt the forbidden art of necromancy and excelled at his craft. When he heard rumours of the "Witches' legacy", he sought the most vicious witch still alive and learnt all he could in exchange for his knowledge on raising the dead. After the witch was killed, he felt free to pursue a path to attaining the Legacy without fear of retribution. [/Spoiler]
